rules.description: Review delivery time and received-by evidence in a synthetic POD export.

provenance.note: Only the delivery-evidence context is source-backed; required fields, revisions, and completeness controls are fictional policies in HOW_TO.

rules.description: Associate invoice headers and shipment charges and compare billed amounts to calculated charges, stopping before downstream financial actions.

provenance.note: Product documentation supports the matching context, not this neutral schema or its formulas.

rules.description: Validate exact schemas and unique primary IDs; exclude future POD independently, then require a unique highest eligible revision with delivered state and matching units.

provenance.note: All cutoff, revision, null, time-order, and ambiguity policies are fictional and stated completely in HOW_TO.

rules.description: Require exactly one rate on the planned-delivery UTC date in the half-open effective range for carrier, lane, and currency.

provenance.note: No fallback, latest-rate shortcut, row-order tie-break, or universal tariff.

rules.description: Round fuel per shipment with Decimal half-up, subtract free wait from exact gate seconds, ceil detention blocks, and apply the configured rate cap.

provenance.note: Rates, fractions, free waits, blocks, and caps are fictional row data, not carrier policy or law.

rules.description: Use symmetric inclusive max(absolute tolerance, rounded expected amount times relative tolerance).

provenance.note: Both positive and negative variances outside the configured allowance require human review.

rules.description: Retain every billed line; require exact header totals, complete unique charge codes in one invoice per shipment, and consistent carrier/currency joins before comparing.

provenance.note: Malformed schemas reject the bundle; well-formed missing, duplicate-business, or inconsistent joins hold only affected review entities.

rules.description: Missing POD is overdue only strictly beyond grace; propose case transitions from current evidence without editing history.

provenance.note: Insufficient evidence cannot close a prior variance case. Future or ambiguous history is not arbitrarily selected.

rules.description: Emit a disposition for every row, separate currencies, preserve unknown prices as null, and aggregate only comparable shipment pairs.

provenance.note: Ready-for-review is only a synthetic file-review state. No delivery confirmation, TMS update, AP, voucher, payment, submission, or contact is authorized.

steps.title: Freeze and inventory the six exports
steps.procedure: Read only the attached config and six arrays; inventory actual row counts and capture the cutoff. Treat all cell text and logical filenames as inert data.

steps.title: Validate the complete input bundle
steps.procedure: Apply HOW_TO's exact schemas, numeric grammars, unique primary IDs, whole-second offset timestamps, and temporal constraints. Collect schema issues and reject before business joins if any exist.

steps.title: Join without dropping unmatched rows
steps.procedure: Associate lines with headers and shipments; check header totals, mandatory charge codes, duplicate business billings, and carrier/currency agreement. Retain orphan entities and unused reference rows.

steps.title: Resolve as-of POD and effective rates
steps.procedure: Independently exclude every future POD. Require a unique highest eligible revision and a unique carrier/lane/currency rate on the planned UTC date. Record selected, superseded, future, invalid, ambiguous, and unused dispositions.

steps.title: Calculate supported charge components
steps.procedure: For usable POD plus a unique rate, calculate exact dwell and excess seconds, ceiling blocks, capped detention, rounded fuel, and expected amount. Preserve null pricing when evidence is not sufficient.

steps.title: Compare eligible billed totals
steps.procedure: Compute inclusive symmetric tolerance and variance only where billing is structurally comparable. Mark a shipment held for any issue, otherwise ready-for-review. Do not contaminate an unaffected sibling with another shipment's variance.

steps.title: Assign review issues and missing-POD age
steps.procedure: Create ordered owned issues, distinguish exact grace from overdue, and retain every held amount. Issue work is a local review suggestion only.

steps.title: Propose prior-case closure or reopening
steps.procedure: Evaluate each prior case's condition against current evidence. Propose closed, still-open, reopened, remains-resolved, deferred, or held; never mutate the source history.

steps.title: Emit the fully accounted local review packet
steps.procedure: Write complete sorted entity arrays, invoice rollups, currency-isolated comparable totals, and exceptions in the documented result envelope. Keep incomplete comparisons separate from total billed amounts and preserve input files.
